channel.title: Gemini 4 Carbon — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: scheduled-price
item.description: 2026-12-01: Standard rates rise to $4 input / $20 output per million tokens. Implicit cache reads rise to $0.20. Batch, Flex and Priority rates also double. Source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing#gemini-4-carbon

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon opens its paid API at Argon’s rates
item.description: Google opened paid API access on 10 November. Standard input, output and implicit cache-read rates double on 1 December.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: launch
item.description: 2026-11-10: Gemini 4 Carbon opens to paid Gemini API customers. Source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-carbon-now-available/

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: observed listing
item.description: Observed ledger change. The model card shows saved quotes and source details; historical observations may lack provenance.
